title: Appraisal Order Update Visit Charge: Billed Add-On Part
content:
### Appraisal Order update visit charge: billed add-on part

The billed add-on part of the update visit charge reads the complexity add-on standing on the order, that is the charges on the gross-living-area surcharge line less any refunds of that line: a standing add-on of 400 dollars or more adds 120 dollars, a standing add-on above zero and under 400 dollars adds 60 dollars, and an order with no standing add-on adds nothing. The billed add-on part is added into the standard update charge.

| Complexity add-on standing on the Appraisal Order | Adds |
|---|---|
| 400.00 dollars or more | 120.00 dollars |
| Above 0.00 and under 400.00 dollars | 60.00 dollars |
| 0.00 (nothing standing) | Nothing |

**How the standing amount is read.** Every charge entry on the order's gross-living-area surcharge line is totalled, and every refund entry on that same line is taken off that total. Entries on other lines of the order are not part of it.

**Hypothetical ledgers.**
- One gross-living-area surcharge charge of 270.00, no refund: standing 270.00, adds 60.00.
- Charges of 150.00 and 270.00 on that line, no refund: standing 420.00, adds 120.00.
- One charge of 150.00 on that line refunded in full: standing 0.00, adds nothing.
- Charges of 400.00 on that line: standing exactly 400.00, adds 120.00.
